app.title: Tool Toss: Spinning Target
app.descr:
Time your tap, throw your tool and make it stick! Tool Toss is a quick, satisfying arcade game about precision and rhythm.

THROW AND STICK
Tap anywhere to throw a tool into the spinning target. Land every tool to break the target and move on. Hit a tool that is already stuck and the run is over.

39 DESIGNED TARGETS
Targets speed up, slow down and reverse direction. Some already have tools stuck in them, so watch the gaps.

BOSS EVERY 5 STAGES
Beat a tougher boss target every fifth stage to unlock a new tool.

COINS AND THE TOOL RACK
Hit the coins on the rim and spend them in the Tool Rack: unlock any of 21 tools, or try a random unlock. A free coin gift is waiting every few hours.

SECOND CHANCE
Missed? Use one Second Chance per run and keep your score.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
- Offline AI assistant answers gameplay questions, right on your device
- Built-in tutorial video with captions
- Help screen explains every rule

CREW CHAT
Chat with your workshop crew; messages are stored locally on your device.

ALSO
- Best score and progress saved on your device
- Sound and vibration settings
- No account needed, plays offline

Ready, aim, toss!
